name: Salesforce Automation System Data Structures
description: Core data structures for Salesforce Flow and Process Automation APIs.

structures.name: FlowDefinition
structures.description: A Salesforce Flow definition record from the Tooling API.

structures.name: FlowInvocationRequest
structures.description: Request to invoke an autolaunched Flow.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: Array of input variable objects passed to the flow.

children.name: <variable_name>
children.description: Input variable value keyed by flow variable API name.

structures.name: FlowInvocationResponse
structures.description: Response from a Flow REST action invocation.

fields.name: actionName
fields.description: Name of the invoked flow action.

fields.name: outputValues
fields.description: Map of output variable names to values.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: Error details if the flow failed.

structures.name: ApprovalRequest
structures.description: Request body for approval process actions.

fields.name: requests
fields.description: List of approval actions to perform.

children.name: contextId
children.description: Record being submitted or acted upon.

structures.name: ApprovalResult
structures.description: Result of an approval process action.

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the record acted upon.

fields.name: instanceStatus
fields.description: Current approval status: Pending | Approved | Rejected | Recalled.

fields.name: newWorkitemIds
fields.description: IDs of created approval work items.
